events.name: A Beautiful Noise (Touring)
events.info: A Beautiful Noise: The Neil Diamond Musical
events.pleaseNote: The venue has a clear bag policy. Parking available in the Convention Center Parking Garage. It is recommended that Will Call tickets are picked up at least 1 hour before showtime. Reserved seating. See elpasolive.com for more info. Please note that the elevator does not go to the Balcony section. Runtime: 2 Hours & 15 minutes, including a 15 min intermission. Everyone needs a ticket, regardless of age. Children under the age of 6 are not allowed at most Broadway in El Paso performances. Some exceptions apply, including special productions for young children such as Blueys Big Play and Paw Patrol. Children must be able to sit quietly in their own seats without disturbing other guests. As a further courtesy to our guests, Broadway in El Paso recommends one parent or chaperone for every one child in attendance. Show and dates are subject to change. Some fees may not be refundable. Ticket policies are at the discretion of the theatre and may be changed at any time.
